cases.prompt: Create a portable skill for this recurring engineering outcome and integrate it with the catalog.
expect: establish a narrow recurring outcome
write compatible metadata
verify behavior

cases.prompt: Tighten this skill's invocation boundary and update its metadata and routing cases.
expect: preserve the owning outcome
keep discovery surfaces consistent

cases.prompt: Evaluate this material skill against realistic positive, negative, and failed-use scenarios, then correct ambiguous instructions.
expect: pin the candidate
forward-test realistic input
rerun after corrections

cases.prompt: Research the current framework API from first-party sources and save the findings.
expect: do not create a skill for documentation lookup

cases.prompt: Implement this settled production feature with tests and broad review.
expect: keep implementation with its owner

cases.prompt: Add a new user-reachable skill but leave the router and public README unchanged.
expect: update router and catalog
keep name, description, and metadata consistent
validate package surfaces

cases.prompt: Revise this skill so that its optional project files stay neutral about version control. Its current rules call them Git-tracked and rely on Git history.
expect: keep skill revision with ko-skill while preserving the target runtime owner
treat the corrected constraint as the target contract
reconcile every conflicting owning rule and required integration surface
do not preserve or introduce version-control policy
rerun exact-candidate proof

cases.prompt: This skill appears to mishandle temporary exclusions. Rewrite its instructions now, then add an evaluation afterwards to show the new wording works.
expect: define a realistic raw evaluation before proposing or making the fix
distinguish a good raw evaluation from a leading evaluation that reveals the intended answer or rationale
pin and exercise the pre-fix candidate
record the observed failure or evidence gap
change the smallest owning rule only when the result justifies it
rerun the evaluation against the exact final candidate

cases.prompt: Revise this description for a skill that follows a pull request through review and CI: Help with pull requests, reviews, CI, GitHub, code, and developer workflows.
expect: write the description for skill selection
state when to use the skill
front-load the key use case and distinguishing trigger terms
replace broad topic words with a bounded monitoring action and outcome

cases.prompt: Polish the wording across this skill so it sounds more professional. Do not change its behavior.
expect: identify that the request supplies no behavioral benefit
do not make an editorial-only skill change
leave the skill unchanged unless the wording improves invocation, agent understanding, decision or action accuracy, safety, verification, or outcome reliability

cases.prompt: Clarify this instruction so the agent can tell whether it must verify the plan or the implementation candidate: Verify it before delivery.
expect: identify the behavioral benefit to agent understanding and verification
make the required referent explicit
do not reject useful clarity as editorial-only polishing

cases.prompt: Create a broad new skill for this one-off question even though reading the official docs answers it.
expect: decline a new skill
require a recurring outcome not solved by documentation lookup

cases.prompt: Add a good and bad example to every rule so agents cannot misunderstand anything.
expect: reject indiscriminate example expansion
require a behavioral benefit for each example
use a good and bad pair only when the contrast defines a boundary or prevents a recurring failure
preserve the instruction as the behavior owner rather than turning examples into hidden templates
